body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 7a329f0316035c2d15b8e48467b66f85d424edbe -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This PR adds documentation and site checks only. It does not change posted G-code, gouge checks, collision checks, stock simulation, geometry, or `crates/ui`.

What looks good:

- The new reference page at `site/content/guide/reference/post-processors.md` covers all items from #3121.
- Each manifest property, hook signature, record format, prelude helper, and refusal entry matches `crates/post/src/post/` and `crates/app/src/posting.rs`.
- `site/content/guide/check-and-post/posting.md` links to `@/guide/reference/post-processors.md`.
- The standalone `post` section warns that the CLI skips the document verification gate and writes output when warnings exist.
- The example script and `.cnc` stream match `js_host.rs`, `cnc.rs`, and `engine.rs`, and produce the four documented lines.
- All three tests in `site/tests/test_post_processor_reference.py` fail under mutation and pass after restoration.
- `docs/decisions/3121-post-processor-reference.md` follows `docs/decisions/README.md`.
- The PR obeys the clean-room, process, dependency, golden, and snapshot rules.

Results merged with main (locally, trial-merged with `upstream/main` at `aa4c785db`, no conflicts):

- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: 0 steps, 0 failed (no files under `crates/` changed).
- `cargo build -p camcraft-post --bin post`: passed.
- Clippy: not applicable because no Rust crate changed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_post_processor_reference.py -v`: 3 passed, 0 failed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_release_022_guide.py -v`: 8 passed, 0 failed.
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -p test_guide_refresh.py -v`: 14 passed, 0 failed.
- Full `site/tests` run without `zola` on `PATH`: 5 errors from missing `zola` and 20 pre-existing failures in unrelated suites (`test_first_4axis_part`, `test_first_continuous_4axis_part`, `test_guide_after_1995`, `test_guide_icons`).

Mutations run locally:

- Remove the `continuousThreading` row from `site/content/guide/reference/post-processors.md`: `test_manifest_properties_have_reference_rows` failed, then passed after restoration.
- Remove `onOpen()` from `site/content/guide/reference/post-processors.md`: `test_engine_hooks_have_reference_entries` failed, then passed after restoration.
- Remove the reference link from `site/content/guide/check-and-post/posting.md`: `test_posting_guide_links_to_reference` failed, then passed after restoration.

Extra suites run:

- Neither extra-suite trigger applies. The diff changes no `testdata/`, fixture directory, golden file, or importer code.
- Related site suites run: `test_post_processor_reference.py` (3 passed), `test_release_022_guide.py` (8 passed), and `test_guide_refresh.py` (14 passed).

Requested before merge:

- None.

Questions / notes (not blocking):

- `crates/post/src/post/cnc_thread.rs` also parses optional `AIR 1` and publishes `Hand` and `StartInAir` in `ThreadRec::props()`. `crates/post/src/post/mod.rs` also emits `Smoothing`, `SmoothingMode`, `SurfaceSpeed`, and `MaxSpindleSpeed` parameters. You can add these in a later update with `docs/CNC-INTERMEDIATE.md`.
- `zola` is not on `PATH` on this review host, so the Zola build checks did not run locally. Template inspection confirms `guide-nav.html` and `section.html` list the new page automatically.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
